description: Tracks a released payment's evidence: reads its Release Evidence Record by rer_id: the policy result at release and the reconcile status as of now (pending, done, overdue or not required). With no rer_id, verifies the organisation's chain of records and returns ok or the first record where it breaks. Read-only. Needs the organisation's key.

rer_id.description: Optional. The Release Evidence Record (rer_...) to read. Omit to verify the organisation's whole chain.

name: release_status
title: Release record status
